name: Kinokuniya Masaru
source:
Masaru is a friend of [url=/c64207]Shuiichi’s[/url] and a bad influence. He's a weirdo who talks like an idiot but cherishes his friendships. Information is his expertise and that occasionally helps Shuuichi out. 

His shirt says "Fresh out of Maintenance". What's that about?

[From [url=https://fruitbatfactory.com/7days/#char]official English page[/url]]
